draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise experiments. Only original-label training (exp1) is reported, with no perturbation conditions, so robustness to label noise was never evaluated. The claim has no support and no defensible narrower version exists.
